claims.statement: For pair Pluecker weights w_jk=Delta_jk^2 of a Parseval 2-frame, vertex marginals d_j=sum_k w_jk, and independent pair samples P,Q, the disjoint collision mass is R_2=1-sum_j d_j^2+sum_{j<k}w_jk^2.
If R_2=0, the nonzero Pluecker support graph of a real rank-2 frame is either a star or a triangle.
In the exact-rank-three heavy-isotropic branch, the triangle endpoint has ||p_Q||_infinity < 3*2^(2/3)*6^(1/3) by a zero-diagonal physical triple.
For a diffuse orthonormal 2D product-projection bank and F_t(xi)=E exp(i xi(S+kappa Z)+it tau Z^2), ||F_t||_2 <= sqrt(2) pi e^(3/4)|tau t|^(-1/2), uniformly in kappa.

In the exact heavy-isotropic star endpoint with 0<c<1 and normalized bank leverage s_k^2/(1-c)+z_k^2<=1/2, phi_Q(t) is O(|t|^-3/2) and ||p_Q||_infinity <=3 sqrt(e)[c(1-c)]^(-1/6)(B^2|tau|)^(-1/3); the density is continuous.
At the leverage-one star endpoint c=1, ||p_Q||_infinity<=6.

For small positive disjoint pair mass R_2, convert the distributed disjoint resource into a paid bank before reciprocal-minor loss, or prove quantitative closeness to the star/triangle endpoints and stabilize their closures.
The universal arbitrary-dimensional three-large-eigenvalue density conjecture remains open; arbitrary complementary spectrum and localized star collars are not closed here.
